name: Create a QDoc
description: Designs UC-1 in a green field: a root module qdocmanagement with the bounded contexts preparation and notifications. A quality manager submits a CreateQDoc request to QDocCreationService; the QDoc aggregate is created active with a document number, and version 1 with the status new, one empty content file and the named authors, reviewers and approvers. QDocCreated is published and the notifications context tells every quality manager. Left to their own changes: the document number format, sequence and uniqueness (UC-2); role and active-account checks on assignees (UC-3), so until then the people named are assigned as given; and editing, history and comments of content files (UC-4), so here a content file only exists. The notification channel stays open (TBD-01).

diagram.value:
sequenceDiagram
  accTitle: Creating a QDoc
  actor QM as Quality manager
  QM->>QDocCreationService: createQDoc(command)
  QDocCreationService->>IdentityProvider: isQualityManager(requestedBy)
  QDocCreationService->>DocumentNumberGenerator: next()
  QDocCreationService->>QDoc: create(command, number)
  QDoc->>Version: createFirst(authors, reviewers, approvers)
  QDocCreationService->>QDocRepository: save(qdoc)
  QDocCreationService->>PreparationEventPublisher: publish(QDocCreated)
  QDocCreationService-->>QM: QDocId
